repo.name: Inkwell
repo.description: Self-hosted F-Droid repo for Inkwell, a native reader and writer for the Standard.site publishing ecosystem on AT Protocol. Source: https://github.com/ewanc26/inkwell-android

apps.description:
Inkwell is a native reader and writer for the Standard.site publishing
ecosystem on AT Protocol.

This is an experimental Android companion to Inkwell for iOS, the primary
client. It is a work in progress toward feature parity, so expect rough
edges.

Read site.standard.publication and site.standard.document records directly
from the author's PDS. Renders Leaflet block content, Markpub/plain text,
and other formats generically so nothing is silently dropped. Resolves
display themes from Leaflet's rich palette through basicTheme to Material 3
defaults. Comments and interactions aren't shown yet.

Discover publications via the cross-platform public index, then fetches
authoritative records from the author. Subscribe to publications and
recommend documents, with live recommend counts from Constellation
(microcosm.blue). Paginated feed with previous/next navigation.

Write and publish site.standard.document records with portable metadata.
Content format selection is presentation-only for now; every publish
currently writes plain text content regardless of the selected format.

Verifies publications and documents against their claimed domain via
Standard.site's .well-known and link-tag checks, shown as a badge on the
post detail screen.

Authentication is OAuth-based with your AT Protocol handle — no app
password required. Silent session restoration on relaunch.

Inkwell is free, with no ads, tracking, or in-app purchases. All code is
AGPL-3.0.
apps.summary: AT Protocol reader and writer for Standard.site
